items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: That's where Oscar Klein and Muriel live. Did you know them? ... I wanted to bring Muriel to America and design a Billie Holiday shim silhouette and let Muriel sing behind that shim

ctx.x: Not well, but I've been...yes, I know, I've been there... been to Zürich.
I was in Zürich Sunday. They're building a new hotel in Zürich. You know the Park? That's where Oscar Klein and Muriel live. Did you know them?
Yeah, I know them. Yeah. He's a nice trumpet player.
